title: Electric field strength
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final answer for part (1): E = (m v₀² sinβ cosβ)/(q L).

title: Maximum velocity condition
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (2): v_m = (q B d)/m.

title: Fourth crossing coordinates
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (3): coordinates are (d, d, 0).

title: Time difference result
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (4): Δt = (2 + 2√2)πm/(qB).

title: Motion analysis in fields
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law and kinematics to relate the electric field to the ion's motion from point A to O.

title: Geometric confinement reasoning
description: Important: For part (2), correctly uses the geometry of the magnetic field regions (r₁ ≤ d and r₂ ≤ 3d) to derive the velocity constraint.

title: Cyclotron motion geometry
description: Important: For parts (3) and (4), correctly calculates the cyclotron radii in both magnetic fields using r = mv/(qB⊥) and analyzes the resulting trajectory patterns.

title: Kinetic energy equivalence
description: Important: For part (4), correctly equates the kinetic energies of ions M and N to find ion N's velocity.

title: Period and intersection analysis
description: Optional: Correctly calculates the cyclotron periods and identifies the first intersection point of the two helical trajectories.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of the electric or magnetic force, or misinterprets the geometry of the magnetic field regions.

title: Radius formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Uses the full magnetic field magnitude B instead of the perpendicular component B⊥ when calculating the radius in the tilted magnetic field II.
